description: tests/test_normalize.py pins the byte-level behavior of the drift normalizer in tether/normalize.py: CRLF/CR to LF folding, BOM stripping, per-line trailing-whitespace removal, EOF-newline collapsing, leading-tab expansion at a configurable tabstop, and binary (non-UTF-8) rejection returning None. Adding, removing, or reordering a normalization step in normalize.py must update these tests.
